## Parent

#197 — PRD: Phone number capture during email registration

## What to build

Add the phone number field end-to-end through the Angular frontend registration flow:

- `RegisterWithEmailRequest` interface (`auth.models.ts`): add `phoneNumber: string`
- `RegisterRequestedPayload` (`register.actions.ts`): add `phoneNumber: string`
- `AuthService.registerWithEmail` (`auth.service.ts`): add `phoneNumber: string` parameter and include it in the payload
- `RegisterEffects` (`register.effects.ts`): destructure `phoneNumber` from action; pass to `authService.registerWithEmail`; add `Auth.PhoneAlreadyInUse` case to `getRegisterErrorMessage` returning `'errors.auth.phoneAlreadyInUseByAnother'`
- `RegisterPageComponent` (`register-page.component.ts`): add `phoneNumber: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(20)]]` to form; add `readonly phoneNumberInputPt = { root: { class: 'register-phone-number-input' } }`; destructure `phoneNumber` in `onSubmit()` and include in dispatched action
- `RegisterPageComponent` template (`register-page.component.html`): insert phone number `<input type="tel" pInputText formControlName="phoneNumber">` field **after Email, before Password**; include validation error paragraph using `register.validation.phoneRequired` transloco key
- i18n — add `"phoneRequired": "Phone number is required."` under `register.validation` in all 9 locale files: `en-IN.json`, `hi-IN.json`, `ta-IN.json`, `te-IN.json`, `bn-IN.json`, `ml-IN.json`, `kn-IN.json`, `mr-IN.json`, `gu-IN.json`
title: Frontend: add phone number field to email registration form and NgRx flow
